note: Protection rules for every GitHub environment a workflow may declare. Read by tests/scripts/test_workflow_environment_concurrency.py to decide which gated jobs may sit in a queueing concurrency group, and re-checked against the live API by scripts/secret_staleness_check.py so this file cannot quietly become a lie. Update it in the same change that arms a reviewer, a wait timer or a branch policy. `deployment_branches: null` means no branch restriction.
